intervals.label: Super Charm-Tau factory project at BINP
intervals.locator: SCTF Conceptual Design Report, Part One, title page
intervals.note: Start = the 2018 conceptual design report (a 'very preliminary draft'); earlier tau-charm factory studies at BINP are cited in it (SLAC-Report-451, 1994; a 1995 'C-Tau in Novosibirsk' CDR) but are a different design. In 2020 BINP was still 'developing a Super Charm-Tau factory project' (arXiv:2005.09878). No approval, funding or construction is reported in the sources fetched, and none is dated after 2020; the project status as of 2026-10-26 is not confirmed.
intervals.quote: CONCEPTUAL DESIGN REPORT PART ONE (physics program, detector) [very preliminary draft] Novosibirsk 2018

name: SCTF universal magnetic detector (conceptual design)
notes: A concept: no detector has been built.

placements.note: Campus-grade placement: the CDR names the Budker Institute (Novosibirsk) but no hall or tunnel position; the marker is the BINP campus point.
placements.quote: This document is focused on a project of the Super Charm Tau factory in the Budker Institute of Nuclear Physics (Novosibirsk, Russia).

summary.plain: The conceptual SCTF detector: a universal magnetic detector with an inner tracker, a drift chamber, aerogel Cherenkov particle identification and a calorimeter, designed for a collision rate of 300 to 400 kHz.
summary.technical: SCTF detector concept (CDR Part One 2018): universal magnetic detector, inner tracker (time projection chamber option, arXiv:2005.09878) and drift chamber, FARICH particle identification, electromagnetic calorimeter, data collection for 300-400 kHz event frequency.

technology.quote: Realisation of the program will require the physical development of a universal magnetic detector with high momentum resolution for charged particles
technology.value: Universal magnetic detector with high momentum resolution for charged particles, high photon energy resolution and record particle identification
